standout_performers.reason: Scored the decisive late goal and was named Player of the Match.

matches.tactical_summary: Canada dominated possession and created the majority of the chances, but struggled to break down a well-organized South African defense for much of the match. South Africa adopted a cautious approach, aiming to absorb pressure and hit on the counter, but ultimately lacked the attacking quality to trouble Canada's goal.

narrative: Canada secured a historic first-ever World Cup knockout stage victory with a dramatic stoppage-time goal from Stephen Eustaquio, sending them into the Quarterfinals. South Africa, despite a valiant defensive effort and reaching the knockout phase for the first time, was unable to find an equalizer and exits the tournament.
next_round_notes: Canada will face the winner of the Netherlands vs. Morocco match in the Quarterfinals. N. Saliba and N. Sigur of Canada received yellow cards, which could be a concern for potential suspensions if they accumulate further bookings. Alphonso Davies' return from injury and appearance off the bench is a significant boost for Canada's attacking options in the next round.
